name: How long does it take to finish the interior of a garage?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to finish the interior of a garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard two-car garage interior finish usually takes between one to three weeks from initial framing to final paint. The project timeline depends heavily on the drying time required between drywall taping coats and whether electrical adjustments are needed before closing up the walls. If your project includes custom finish carpentry like built-in workbenches or cabinetry, that adds a few days toward the end. Working with an owner-operated team ensures clear communication regarding daily schedules, minimizing downtime between the framing, drywall, and painting stages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most garage finishing projects take one to three weeks, depending on drying times for drywall mud, electrical rough-ins, and custom carpentry additions.
